_comment: Machine source for RNVizion identity facts, the sibling of engine/brand.py. Brand tokens are colors and type; these are the facts about the person and the products. Same rule applies: import it, never hardcode. Change a fact HERE first, then run refresh_profile.py --all to find every surface that disagrees.

identity._comment: Contact and handles. Byte-identical everywhere they appear.
identity.name: Christian Smith

role._comment: Current employment. Tracked because it appears on six surfaces and WILL change; when it does, the old title goes straight into retired[].
role.title: AR/VR Sales & Support Specialist

tagline._comment: The one-line positioning. Variants are allowed and expected; the checker looks for the stem, not the whole sentence, so a page can extend it without failing.
tagline.canonical: Building production AI systems, and the developer tools they run on.

bio._comment: The standing author bio. Ships on every post; must match /bio/.
bio.canonical: is a Python developer building production AI systems on the Claude API, an AR/VR Sales & Support Specialist at Meta, and a self-described modern-day Renaissance man. He ships retrieval systems, LLM agents, and the developer tools they run on; he also writes fiction, makes art, builds things by hand, and is figuring out the rest as he goes.

facts._comment: Values on more than one surface that have drifted before. 'sources' are files the checker reads; 'appears_in' is the wider map including surfaces it cannot reach.

projects.note: Stat block and the count of project articles must agree.

tests.note: og-image.png is generated from this; never typed twice.

eval_cases.note: Shape-only on public surfaces per the standing rule. Split is 37 in-corpus, 21 out-of-corpus.

eval_thresholds._comment: The three gates. Declared in rnv-ask-the-corpus/eval/thresholds.json and quoted on the resume; the checker verifies the two agree.

products._comment: The three-layer naming rule as data. display = product name, repo = slug, deployment = platform ID. Where they diverge, the reason is recorded so nobody 'corrects' it later.
products.exempt_reason: The org namespace already carries the brand; renaming yields the stutter rnvizion-rnv-ask-the-corpus.hf.space and breaks URLs printed on resumes in circulation.
products.note: The PRODUCT NAME did not change when the repo was renamed. Never 'RNV Ask the Corpus'.
Renamed 2026-07-28 to follow the RNV [Noun] rule.
Always model-agnostic MCP; never grouped with Claude-API systems.
Apache-2.0 reference implementation. Never 'open standard' or 'open proposal'.

repos._comment: Every repo the checker knows how to fetch and check with --all. 'checks' selects which groups apply; a library repo has no bio to check.

retired.reason: AIII stood down its standards bid 2026-07-23; it is an Apache-2.0 reference implementation.
retired.exempt_reason: NOTICE states AIII interoperates with open standards including MCP and IETF/WIMSE. Composing on standards is not claiming to be one.
The res-count case note names it. A note field, not matched against retrieval. This is the case the 'Honest and Wrong' essay is built on.

retired.reason: Hotbox DC is described as 'a regulated startup'.
Heading is 'Selected Projects'; parsers map it more reliably.

retired.exempt_reason: The docstring cites the 5,003-vs-5,021 drift as the reason the script exists.

retired.reason: Eval suite is 58 cases; public surfaces use shape-only phrasing anyway.

renamed_repos._comment: GitHub redirects cover these, but a link teaches the old name.

protected._comment: Strings that look like the renamed repos but must NEVER be rewritten. Hugging Face Space IDs are deliberately exempt from the rnv- prefix.
